snippet.title: Winx Club: The Magic is Back - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Winx Club: The Magic Is Back releases on April 30th! 🧚‍♀️ 
The fantasy adventure will be available on Nintendo Switch, PC, and PS5.

Step into an all-new adventure inspired by Winx Club's new animated series. Explore iconic locations across the Magic Dimension, from the halls of Alfea College to the Enchanted Forest, the shimmering Coastal Cliffs, and the mysterious Desert Ruins of Red Fountain. Switch between all six Winx fairies, using each one’s unique magical abilities to battle enemies, unlock puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets.

Team up with a friend in two-player local co-op as you take on powerful foes together. Whether you are a lifelong Winx fan or meeting the fairies for the first time, this heroic journey delivers fast-paced action, colorful worlds, right at the heart of what makes Winx Club a global phenomenon.

Learn more: 
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10016199
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4007490
